description: Baseline control run: unmodified main through the exact Stage A harness. Establishes the reference DA / net PnL / p-value that every idea's promotion bar is defined relative to. NOT an idea — the fixed measuring stick.
notes: train-eval --fold 77 --seeds 3 --max-epochs 20 --device cuda. Fold 77 is the pinned Stage A fold for the whole loop. All later bars: DA >= baseline_DA+0.015 AND net PnL > max(0, baseline_PnL) AND p<0.2. Pre-flight (2026-07-08): pytest 257 passed, mypy/ruff clean, GPU idle (804MB desktop only), push auth OK.
